item.title: Production-ready, AI-assisted Development and Workflows
item.description: Anyone who's tried using the frontier AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or Open AI Codex will know that they can rapidly accelerate development, generating new code much faster than a typical human developer. But that still leaves a big question - is AI-generated code ready to deliver and safe for production? It's one thing for your code to be "demo-ready", but that's not necessarily the same thing as it being secure, resilient, observable, and cost-effective etc.
